chose: slug lists ship to the model as {{...}} prompt variables substituted at execution time, alongside {{recipe_json}}
over: keeping them interpolated into FALLBACK_PROMPT at module load
retyping them into the PostHog prompt text
because: the PostHog copy is the one a PR diff cannot see; as inline text it could silently disagree with schema.ts's zod enums. As variables, a schema.ts edit reaches the model on the next job whichever prompt text won the fetch

chose: only {{recipe_json}} is required by buildMessages; every other variable is best-effort, and recipe_json substitutes LAST
over: throwing when a slug-list variable is absent from the prompt text
because: a published PostHog version predating a variable is a normal state (it carries the list inline) and must keep classifying rather than fail the queue. Last-substitution ordering means a user-supplied recipe name like {{diet_slugs}} cannot expand into one of our lists

chose: isLlmFresh compares llm_model plainly but llm_prompt_version only when the current version is known (non-null)
over: comparing prompt version symmetrically, so a null current version counts as differing
because: a null current version means the PostHog fetch degraded to the code FALLBACK_PROMPT; symmetric comparison would turn every PostHog outage into a corpus-wide re-enrichment, then a second one when PostHog came back. A null STORED model, by contrast, is a real unknown answerer and should re-run.

chose: not widening LLM_BACKFILL_CLAIM_SQL for model/prompt-version — measured 0 production callers of claimLlmBatch
over: adding llm_model/llm_prompt_version arms to the backfill claim so a prompt release re-enriches the whole corpus
because: grep for claimLlmBatch finds only its definition in lib/load.ts and load.db.test.ts; no llm-backfill job is registered on the queue. Widening it builds a mechanism with zero subjects. Consequence to know: the new isLlmFresh check only fires on recipes that already get an llm-enrich job enqueued. Re-run that grep before assuming the gap survives — once an llm-backfill worker exists, the claim SQL is where the freshness rule has to be repeated.
